description: Figure 7 illustrates the change in KV cache size over time, measured in megabytes, for different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled “time (seconds)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick labels at 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, and 60. The y-axis is labeled “KV cache (MB)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1600, with tick labels at 0, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000, 1200, 1400, and 1600. There are four lines displayed: a solid blue line representing “Vanilla (n=64)”, which begins at approximately 800 MB at time 0 seconds and increases to approximately 1600 MB at time 60 seconds; a solid orange line representing “SepLM (n=64)”, which begins at approximately 400 MB at time 0 seconds and increases to approximately 600 MB at time 60 seconds; a dashed orange line representing “SepLM (n=128)”, which begins at approximately 800 MB at time 0 seconds and increases to approximately 1200 MB at time 60 seconds; and a dashed orange line representing “SepLM (n=256)”, which begins at approximately 1200 MB at time 0 seconds and increases to approximately 1600 MB at time 60 seconds.
